# CANUDANCE

CANUDANCE is an independent underground electronic music and rave platform based in Marrakech, Morocco.
Official website: https://canudance.com/
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/CANUDANCEEE/

## Current transmission
CANUDANCE 001 — TRANSMISSION 001
Date: 26 September 2026
Time: 22:00 to dawn
City: Marrakech, Morocco
Location: revealed through official CANUDANCE channels 24 hours before the transmission.
Artists: IRIS, BOO!, SC4EAMER
Tagline: NO NOISE. JUST SIGNAL.
